 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Mr. Pramod Kumar Pandey, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party/B.S.F.C in both these cases.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 409,
420, 379 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The prosecution case, as per written report of informant, who is Co-Operative Extension Officer,
in brief, is that in the year 2022-2023, the Kunjwa PACS under Bihta block was provided government fund from the Patliputra Central co- operative Bank and Last date for supply of CMR was 30.09.2023.
However, the Kunjwa PACS neither supplied CMR nor returned amount.

It is alleged that chairman and Manager of Kunjwa PACS namely Madhuri Devi and Ramji Saw (petitioners in Cr.Misc. No.53184/2025), in connivance with Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.53184 of 2025(3) dt.08-09-2025 other members of PACS (petitioners in Cr.Misc. No. 51205/2025), out of total purchased paddy i.e. 8125.9 quintal, sold 4317.21 quintal paddy in the open market and thus,
embezzled the government fund amounting to Rs. 1,01,44,511/-.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that due to some unavoidable circumstances, the paddy could not be supplied, however petitioners are ready to deposit the alleged amount i.e. Rs.
1,01,44,511/- in the concerned bank account.
He further submits that at the time furnishing bail-bonds, petitioners shall deposit 20% of the alleged defalcated amount i.e. Rs. 20,28,902/-.
Petitioners claim clean antecedent.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of B.S.F.C. does not oppose the prayer for anticipatory bail on the point of payment of alleged embezzled government fund.

6.
